confidence_notes: Doha meal and cappuccino prices are fairly well bounded by current crowd-sourced data. Alcohol prices vary across licensed venues; cocktail and wine estimates follow their local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation estimates are less certain because of seasonality and Doha’s limited hostel market.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates place Doha above Sharm El Sheikh, below Tel Aviv, and generally below Fethiye and Antalya. Business and tourism demand are balanced by Doha’s large hotel supply.
